items.title: Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits
items.body: When adventure calls, the Straw Hats answer! Set sail with Monkey D. Luffy, Nami, and Usopp Outfits and chart a course to uncharted waters.

items.title: Keep Tabs on the Adventure!
items.body: All great adventures begin with a treasure map! Head to the Treasure Tab to follow along with weekly progress and chart your next move.

items.title: Going Merry Glider
items.body: Sail to victory and chart your own course with the Going Merry Glider!

items.title: SCALE
items.body: Embark on a co-op physics extraction horror game in SCALE, created by Monki Studios! Search for valuables, carry your haul using physics, and survive monsters with unique behaviors as a crew. Reach quota and upgrade your gear to go even deeper next time.
